commands.name: Add a source operation
commands.sourceMeaning: Place a chosen C# expression or statement at the selected document position, including any declarations needed to use its result.
preconditions: The insertion site belongs to an editable document and resolves in the current compilation.
The user has selected an operation, its operands and how its result will be used.
requiredChecks: Bind the new operation; check argument modes, conversions, overload selection and result type.
Check lexical scope, definite assignment and the destination document.
Preview the affected text and diagnostics, then recheck document and context revisions before applying an undoable edit.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Show the added execution or evaluation and describe its intended effect before applying it.

commands.name: Supply an expression
commands.sourceMeaning: Replace an operand at its use site, or introduce a local whose value or reference is reused when that alternative is explicitly chosen.
preconditions: The receiving expression and proposed input bind in the selected project context.
The choice between evaluating an expression and reusing a previously stored result is explicit.
requiredChecks: Compare evaluation counts, ordering, conditional execution and exception timing, including receiver and argument effects.
Rebind overloads and conversions; check nullability, definite assignment and any lifetime or alias restrictions.
Show all introduced locals, casts and affected text; reject a candidate whose preservation claim lacks evidence.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Identify any intended difference in calls, values or effects; caching must be visible as a behavior change.

commands.name: Reshape control flow
commands.sourceMeaning: Rewrite C# sequencing or a structured construct according to the selected control operation. A drawn edge alone cannot schedule work.
preconditions: The source and destination resolve to statement or region boundaries with known ownership.
The intended sequence, branch or loop rewrite has a defined C# expansion.
requiredChecks: Validate every exit and target against scope, loop and protected-region rules.
Retain short-circuiting, exception handling, cleanup and return ordering unless the requested change explicitly alters them.
Inspect the candidate for unrequested jumps or task scheduling, and bind any explicitly chosen await or coordination API.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Explain the changed paths and operation starts, including any effect of starting work before an earlier result is awaited.

commands.name: Remove an input connection
commands.sourceMeaning: Omit an optional argument when legal, substitute a user-selected expression, or perform another explicit source replacement.
preconditions: The current use site is known and editable.
A legal omission or a concrete replacement has been chosen; a detached wire is insufficient.
requiredChecks: Rebind the call or enclosing expression after the edit, including overloads and optional-parameter values.
Account for effects removed with the old input; do not silently insert a fallback value.
Regenerate the graph from the candidate and check for unresolved required inputs and new diagnostics.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Display the replacement or omission and state which evaluations or supplied values will change.

commands.name: Remove source behavior
commands.sourceMeaning: Delete the selected source span with an explicit disposition for its result users and attached comments.
preconditions: The removal span and all known dependent uses have been identified.
Required outputs have replacements, or remaining source diagnostics will be shown for deliberate follow-up editing.
requiredChecks: Inspect scope changes, result dependencies and diagnostics in the affected context.
Review comment ownership and ensure untouched text is preserved.
Enumerate removed effects and check that the graph represents the resulting source, including incomplete uses.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Make the deleted execution and any unresolved dependents visible in the proposed source change.

commands.name: Copy executable structure
commands.sourceMeaning: Insert a second copy of chosen C# structure at a specified document location, resolving references for that destination.
preconditions: The user selected a semantic copy and an editable destination.
The selection has known declarations, captured values and source boundaries.
requiredChecks: Resolve collisions in declaration and label names, imports and referenced symbols.
Check capture meaning, scope and binding in the destination compilation.
Count added evaluations and executions; duplicating a view must never invoke this operation implicitly.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Show the inserted source and describe the additional work it can perform.

commands.name: Reorder source evaluation
commands.sourceMeaning: Move selected statements or expressions to a new source order under an explicitly requested semantic edit.
preconditions: Both positions and the affected expressions have resolved source owners.
The request states whether equivalence is required or a particular behavior change is intended.
requiredChecks: Analyze reads, writes, aliases and assignment dependencies across the move.
Check scope, condition coverage, exception timing and cleanup boundaries.
Treat calls, accessors, conversions and overloaded operators as potentially effectful; refuse an equivalence claim when their ordering cannot be justified.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Explain how the new ordering changes observations, or provide the evidence for preserving them.

commands.name: Introduce a C# callable
commands.sourceMeaning: Replace a selected region with a call to a newly declared method, local function or other chosen C# abstraction.
preconditions: The selected boundary has known inputs, outputs, captured storage and control exits.
A destination and callable form can express the region without changing its observable behavior.
requiredChecks: Rebind parameters, return values and captures; preserve reference passing and mutable storage identity.
Check exits, cleanup, exceptions and the placement of evaluations relative to the new call.
Retain async and iterator semantics, including suspension, deferred execution and lifetime restrictions.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Show the declaration and replacement call as a preservation operation; any intended behavior change requires a separate explicit edit and preview.

commands.name: Revise a declared symbol
commands.sourceMeaning: Edit a declaration's name, signature, visibility, type or members together with the affected references in the chosen scope.
preconditions: The symbol, participating documents and available host refactoring services are known.
The requested scope can be applied coherently, and unavailable project contexts are identified.
requiredChecks: Rebind affected uses, overloads and destinations, including partial and linked declarations.
Validate each known compilation context and list any contexts that remain unevaluated.
Use supported host refactoring and document transactions; detect intervening edits before committing the candidate.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Show the affected declarations and references and explain any intended change to callers or runtime behavior.

commands.name: Adjust the graph view
commands.sourceMeaning: Update layout or view metadata for position, routing, grouping, folding or annotations; the C# document receives no edit.
preconditions: The command is identified as a view operation and has the relevant metadata revision.
Existing user layout data can be retained or a revision conflict can be reported.
requiredChecks: Compare C# document bytes before and after the operation; no formatting or normalization is allowed.
Preserve unrelated user metadata and detect conflicting layout revisions.
Ensure grouping and copying a view neither extracts nor duplicates executable code.

behaviorChange.previewRequirement: Identify the operation as a view adjustment; a request to change behavior must use a semantic command with its own source preview.
